mentions.name: Wherewhen
mentions.description: Wherewhen is a travel planner that lets users lock in fixed times (e.g., a restaurant reservation) and automatically rearranges the rest of the itinerary around those anchors.
mentions.problem: Existing travel planners lacked the features the author wanted, so nothing had everything needed.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.wherewhen.cc/, a travel planner, because nothing had everything I wanted. Wherewhen allows you to fix some times (eg a restaurant reservation) and moves everything else around that.
mentions.author: stavros
